Annotations rolled back with the timeline (mitcad#1756), on a reported design (opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/annotations-rolled-back-reported-test.cmake): 172 features, the sketch the owner edited (F44) the 37th; two material labels (Material1, Material2) on bodies of later features (F132.b0, F113.b0), a dimension (Offset1) on a body of an earlier one.
Editing the sketch puts the marker right after it: the labels are rolled back with those features, without a warning; the dimension stays measured.
The sketch finished: the marker at the end again, nothing rolled back, no warning.
